description: Source code for PduR logic handling in AUTOSAR platform, including buffer management, transmission, and indication functions.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_AllocateUpRxBuffer
methods.description: Allocates an upper receive buffer for a given PDU ID.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_AllocateRxBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a receive buffer for a given PDU ID and transport protocol SDU length.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_AllocateTxBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a transmit buffer for a given PDU ID and length.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_ReleaseRxBuffer
methods.description: Releases the receive buffer associated with a PDU ID.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_ReleaseTxBuffer
methods.description: Releases the transmit buffer associated with a PDU ID.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_Transmit
methods.description: Transmits a PDU through all destination modules.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RxIndicationTT
methods.description: Handles receive indication with trigger transmit for a destination.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RxIndicationDirect
methods.description: Handles direct receive indication for a destination.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RxIndicationWithUpBuffer
methods.description: Handles receive indication with buffer management and forwarding.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_TpRxIndication
methods.description: Handles transport protocol receive indication, manages buffers and notifications.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_RxIndication
methods.description: Main receive indication handler, routes incoming PDUs based on module type and configuration.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_TxConfirmation
methods.description: Handles transmission confirmation, manages buffer states and counts.

methods.name: PduR_ARC_TriggerTransmit
methods.description: Provides data for transmission on request.
